newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish February T-bill auction draws higher rates.
newsitem.headline: Danish February T-bill auction draws higher rates.

text.p: Denmark's central bank said on Thursday its monthly treasury bill auction resulted in minimum rates of 3.54 percent for the four-month series and 3.58 percent for the seven-month series.
One month ago, the four-month series, then with a maturity of five months, yielded 3.53 percent. The seven-month series, which had a maturity of eight months then, yielded 3.57 percent.
The central bank said it sold 988.3 million crowns ($153.5 million) worth of the four-month series and 979.4 million crowns worth of the seven-months series, giving a total of 1.968 billion crowns.
